description: The tavern has timber wall panelling, a real arched saloon doorway with swing-door leaves, back-bar bottle shelves, an L-shaped counter, a horizontal tap cask, closed coopered barrels, four bar stools and three customer tables. Repeated bottles, mugs, tables, stools and lanterns share GLBs. The iron wheel chandelier and wall lanterns use separate shared luminous glass geometry; the capture uses three small unshadowed warm lights plus ambient and directional light. The English TAVERN sign and stag pennant preserve the reference identity.
differences: The 7.4 × 6.8m layout and back-of-house construction are inferred. The source has a denser, more irregular bottle assortment, varied mugs, richer upholstery and more detailed wall pictures. This version uses an original simplified stag emblem and a botanical picture in place of the detailed landscape. Round-table construction and chandelier chains are simplified for the reusable kit. The rendered review uses warm Mobile lighting; Blender orthographic views use the neutral source lights to expose geometry.
collision: Simple volumes block tables, bars, barrels and stools. The saloon-door leaf geometry is static and the room wall collision remains a containment boundary; this is not an operational door or tavern gameplay implementation.
